description: Original gold-and-bronze digital twin illustration. The architecture is conceptual and does not depict a verified university campus.
prompt: Create one polished image asset for a university government communication digital twin LOGIN PAGE, not a screenshot or whole webpage. Portrait 3:4 composition, no text, no letters, no logos, no UI cards. Cinematic conceptual illustration in warm bronze, muted gold, espresso brown, ivory; absolutely no blue or green. Lower half: elegant cream Islamic academic architecture with dome, minarets and palm trees reflected in a calm pool, an imagined academic setting rather than an identifiable real campus. On the lower right a graceful translucent abstract human head in profile facing left, constructed of delicate glowing golden network points and fine triangular connections, conceptual digital intelligence. Atmospheric soft sunlight and a subtle gold haze. Upper 40 percent predominantly dark warm brown with ample smooth quiet negative space for white Arabic headlines that will be placed separately in HTML. Left lower area also calm and dark enough for a small caption. Premium editorial visual, sophisticated restrained futuristic aesthetic, realistic architecture blended with digital sculpture, no neon clutter, no watermark. This is an original conceptual backdrop inspired by a reference with academic architecture and a wireframe head, adapted to Al Qasimia University gold/cream branding without claiming to depict its real campus.
